comparisons.incident_title: Payment Service 500 Spike after Canary Rollout
comparisons.ground_truth: Missing STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable in v2.4.1 deployment manifest caused NullPointerException in WebhookHandler on /pay
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Missing environment secret 'STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET' introduced in deployment DEP-101 (v2.4.1) causing unhandled NullPointerException in WebhookHandler.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Application threw NullPointerException during payment processing; possible unhandled code bug or malformed customer payload.

comparisons.incident_title: Order Service Database Connection Pool Starvation & Timeout Cascade
comparisons.ground_truth: Unindexed query 'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = pending' executed by analytics worker acquired and held all 50 connection pool slots
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by long-running unindexed query ('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = pending') saturating all 50 connection slots.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Database query timeout detected; suspecting database host CPU overload or network latency between order-service and DB.

comparisons.incident_title: Auth Service Host Node Disk Exhaustion (/var/log at 100%)
comparisons.ground_truth: Logrotate failure due to invalid permissions (chmod 777 error) combined with debug logging left active filled 50GB partition to 100%
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Host disk space exhausted (/var/log at 100%) caused by logrotate permission failure (file mode 0777 instead of 0644) combined with unrotated debug logging.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Disk space exhausted on host /var/log; application unable to write session logs.

comparisons.incident_title: Inventory Service Memory Leak and OOMKilled Container Cascade
comparisons.ground_truth: Commit 4a7ef1 introduced static unbounded LRU cache holding SKU reservation payloads without TTL or eviction limit
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Pod CrashLoopBackOff caused by Linux OOM killer (exit code 137) due to unbounded in-memory reservation cache without TTL or eviction limit.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Service pod terminated with exit code 137 (OOMKilled); heap memory limit exceeded.

comparisons.incident_title: Notification Worker Threadpool Starvation via Upstream SendGrid Socket Hang
comparisons.ground_truth: Upstream SendGrid API endpoint experiencing 30s TCP packet drop without client socket timeout or circuit breaker configured
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Worker thread pool exhaustion caused by 30-second socket timeouts against upstream provider (api.sendgrid.com) without circuit breaker fallback.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Worker threads timed out reading from external API socket; suspecting local network interface saturation.

comparisons.incident_title: Ingress Gateway Edge SSL Certificate Expiration & Handshake Failures
comparisons.ground_truth: cert-manager ACME DNS-01 challenge failed because Cloudflare API token expired 3 days ago, preventing automated renewal before certificate expiry
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Edge TLS handshake failure caused by SSL certificate expiration after cert-manager automated ACME renewal failed due to expired Cloudflare DNS API token.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: TLS certificate expired on edge gateway; manual certificate renewal required.

comparisons.incident_title: Catalog Service Redis Cache Stampede on Black Friday Hot Key
comparisons.ground_truth: Key 'catalog:deals:flash-sale' expired at 15:00:00Z without mutex locking or TTL jitter, causing 12,000 concurrent requests to stampede Postgres DB
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Redis cache stampede: simultaneous expiration of hot key 'catalog:deals:flash-sale' caused 12,000 requests to hit backend Postgres, spiking CPU to 99.4%.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: High database CPU utilization and query backlog; recommended scaling database instance size.

comparisons.incident_title: API Gateway False-Positive 429 Rate Limiting via Internal Node IP Flattening
comparisons.ground_truth: Reverse proxy config update omitted 'real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For', causing rate limiter to bucket all users under internal node IP 10.244.0.1
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: False-positive HTTP 429 rate limit storm: ingress configuration omitted 'real_ip_header X-Forwarded-For', collapsing all user traffic into a single node IP (10.244.0.1) bucket.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: High rate of HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; suspecting distributed bot attack or scraper traffic.

comparisons.incident_title: Billing Consumer Partition Rebalance Loop triggered by Poison Pill Message
comparisons.ground_truth: Poison pill message with negative currency decimal caused regex hang exceeding max.poll.interval.ms (300s), triggering continuous consumer group rebalances
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Kafka consumer partition rebalance loop triggered by poison pill message at offset 8492048 hanging regex validation beyond max.poll.interval.ms (300s).
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Kafka consumer commit failed; suspecting Kafka broker cluster instability or network partition.

comparisons.incident_title: User Profile Service Inter-Service RPC 401s after Vault Key Auto-Rotation
comparisons.ground_truth: Vault auto-rotated JWT private signing key, but user-profile-service had hardcoded 24h JWKS in-memory cache with no fallback to re-fetch on unknown kid
comparisons.investigator_diagnosis: Inter-service RPC 401 Unauthorized spike: Vault auto-rotated signing key ('key-2026-11-b'), but user-profile-service cached old JWKS for 24 hours without cache-busting.
comparisons.baseline_diagnosis: Inter-service 401 Unauthorized error; client service web-frontend may have sent invalid credentials.
